newsitem.title: USA: Star Medical Corp to acquire EchoMEDIA.
newsitem.headline: Star Medical Corp to acquire EchoMEDIA.

text.p: Star Medical Corp said on Monday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of multimedia services company echoMEDIA, including licenses, technology and contracts.

Terms of the transaction were not available, but Netmaster Ltd, which recently acquired control of Star Medical, has agreed to provide funding of up to $5 million in debt and equity to Star during 1997, Star Medical said in a statement.
Star Medical also said it expected revenues for the fiscal year 1997 to reach $6 million.
